verdict.rationale: Ollama is a local model runtime, so on-device speech transcription is a fair question for it and the axis applies. However, the evidence pack never mentions audio input, speech-to-text, dictation, or real-time transcription. The only documented modalities are chat, image generation, and general multimodal support, none of which covers this story.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can dictate speech that gets transcribed in real time by an on-device model
